generation: Two format versions, three modes (1-bit Bitmap, 8-bit gray, 8-bit RGB), three widths (1, 9, 129), four packet forms. Three rows per channel. No random inputs. All source bytes, raw controls and hashes retained.

sourceReview.finding: Compressed rows longer than twice the decoded row size plus one are rejected before decoding. The 18 dense-noop errors match this bound; no pixel differences in the other 54.

Image-level decoding computes max(width * depth // 8, 1), causing the 16 odd-width Bitmap errors already recorded in 2026-09-05-next-psd-bitmap.json. Calling its independent low-level decoder with the byte-aligned row size matches every Raw control.

conclusion: No confirmed new reader defect in this batch. Legal dense no-ops and odd-width rows remain accepted with exact pixels. Native rejection is not adopted as a reader contract. Productive/incomplete tail tolerance remains an unproven visible-user defect and is deferred.
limitations: No actual reader JPEG/file-entry/WeChat/physical-device run in this exploration.
Raw ImageMagick control validates pixel interpretation, not the RLE stream; independent psd-tools low-level decoding separately checks legal stream contents.
No new product version or release from this evidence-only change.
